title: Mycobacterium Tuberculosis Kompleks Suşlarında İlaç Direncinin Real-Time PCR İle Hçızlı Tespiti İçin Anyplex™ II MTB/MDR/XDR Kitinin Değerlendirilmesi
author: EKER, Emel
license_note: Zenodo record metadata license field: cc-by-4.0

steps.title: Assemble clinical sample set
steps.instruction: Gather two consecutive cohorts: 44 MDR‑MTBC isolates and 50 ARB‑positive sputum specimens collected in the study.

steps.title: Phenotypic identification and DST
steps.instruction: Identify Mycobacterium tuberculosis complex phenotypically and determine drug susceptibility first with the BACTEC MGIT 960 system for first‑line anti‑TB drugs, then with the Löwenstein‑Jensen agar proportion (LJ‑AP) method for second‑line drugs.

substeps.instruction: Perform MTBC identification on each isolate.
Run first‑line drug susceptibility testing using the BACTEC MGIT 960 system.
Run second‑line drug susceptibility testing using the Löwenstein‑Jensen agar proportion method.

steps.title: Multiplex real‑time PCR for resistance
steps.instruction: Using the Anyplex™ II MTB/MDR/XDR Detection kit (Seegene), perform a multiplex real‑time PCR on all 94 samples to simultaneously detect MTBC DNA and the mutations associated with MDR and XDR resistance.

substeps.instruction: Prepare PCR reactions according to the kit’s instructions for each sample.
Load the reactions onto the real‑time PCR instrument and run the recommended cycling program.
Analyse the amplification data to determine MTBC presence and the presence of resistance‑conferring mutations.
